tools.name: screen_name
tools.description: Screen a person or entity name against OFAC SDN, EU consolidated, and UN sanctions lists. Returns match status, confidence, and list source.

tools.name: screen_wallet
tools.description: Screen a cryptocurrency wallet address against OFAC SDN sanctions list. Returns match status and any associated sanctioned entity.

tools.name: get_sanctions_lists
tools.description: List all supported sanctions lists with last-updated dates and entity counts.
